$comment: What the app may cost a reader, measured by AquaTomeUITests/PerformanceTests and checked by scripts/check-perf.py (ios.yml, job app) against the median of each test's runs, on the CI simulator (iPhone 17, iOS 26.5, Debug build). A budget only tightens: one raised says why in its reason (docs/governance.md, Mobile apps rule 5). Each first value is the first CI run's median plus headroom, rounded.

budgets.name: Launch to the first screen answering touches
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-01 from 4.7 s: the same app launched in 2.45–4.86 s on hosted runners (2.45 on #312, 2.88, 3.44, 3.80, 3.90, 4.02 on main after #333, 4.16, 4.28, 4.61, and 4.86 on PR #333). #333 made no difference measured on one Mac: medians 1.467 and 1.445 s before it, 1.407 and 1.427 s after, runs interleaved on one simulator. Budget: the slowest seen ×1.25

budgets.name: CPU time flinging through 800 fish
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-02 from 3.4 s: other runners again, not slower code. The same app measured 2.846 s on PR #383 (6956b0b8) and 3.466 s on main after it (5c64e307); #375 measured 2.873 s on its PR (b041bcc4) and 3.527 s on main after it (2cd2ee1d), where its only change runs when a test opens a web page, which this test doesn't. Launch rose on the same runners (5.21 and 5.86 s, against 3.79–4.62 s on the others). Hosted runners have now read 2.12–3.53 s with nothing in the fling changed. Raised on 2026-11-01 from 2.2 s for the same reason (1.44–2.72 s then). Budget: the slowest seen, 3.527 s, ×1.25. Next: measure the fling against a fixed piece of work on the same runner, so the runner's speed cancels out and a smaller slowdown is caught

budgets.name: Memory at its peak while flinging through 800 fish
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-01 from 75,500 kB for the Tìm tab's home of shelves (#316): the commit before it and #316 measured on one Mac, 75,991 → 77,581 kB (CI: 74,537 → 76,438 kB). Not cards kept: every build levels off after two runs, and a list that reuses its rows measured the same (77,597 kB). A heap diff after the same flings by hand puts the rest in the home staying alive under the shelf: more SwiftUI types (+442 kB metadata, +306 kB method caches), their observation and closure records (about 0.9 MB), and the shelves' own copy of the items (+397 kB). Not a leak: twenty runs in one launch hold flat (69.3–69.6 and 69.9–70.1 MB in two launches), and the five-run measurement above rose in one step of about 6 MB, then held flat. Worth it: the owner asked for the site's home in the app. Budget: CI median 76,438 kB ×1.1

budgets.name: App size, as archived for the App Store (all files, before Apple's encryption and thinning)
budgets.reason: raised 2026-11-04 from 3255 kB for the app's anonymous telemetry (#500): usage events, their queue and sending, the site's and the reader's switches, and iOS's crash and performance reports cut to what the privacy policy names. CI read 3,293.452 kB on #500 (144e985d, run 41810629507), over main's 3,132 kB. Measured on one Mac (Release archive, main 4d55699d → 144e985d): 3165.5 → 3326.9 kB, +161.4 kB: the binary +158.8 kB, from 168.7 kB more code and metadata laid out in 16 kB pages (the kit's Telemetry module 116.1: events, their checks against the contract, the queue and its file, sending and waiting, the report filter; the native page's reading marks 9.7 and the page reading 6.4; the app's model and MetricKit 9.6; the app's root 7.5; the switch, in the list and on the empty tab, 6.1; the hooks in the handbook, shelf, tank, light, plug and post code 9.4; linker data 3.1), the privacy manifest 2.1, the Indonesian and Thai strings 0.4. Trimmed 35.0 kB: the queue's file and the requests written with JSONSerialization instead of Codable, no Equatable, and the stand-in Worker and the policy's field lists out of Release builds (Telemetry 116.1 → 83.3 kB, two text pages and one data page fewer): 3291.9 kB on this Mac, about 3258.5 kB as CI reads it (this Mac read 33.4 kB above CI on main and on #500 alike), still over. The text segment grows in 16 kB pages and the next page down needs 15.6 kB less code, more than is left to cut without dropping what the policy or the contract asks for. Budget: 3258.5 kB ×1.1, rounded to 5 kB; set it to CI's reading of this head ×1.1 once job app has read it
